outcome_evidence: Running processes/containers (ps aux; docker ps -a): java Keycloak 26.4.6 (port 8080), dotnet backend (5000), ng serve (4200), docker mssql 2022 (1433) all Up.

HTTP probes: http://localhost:8080/ -> 302; http://localhost:4200/ -> 200 with <title>Leipziger Strassennamen</title>; http://localhost:5000/swagger/index.html -> 200; http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse (no token) -> 401.

End-to-end auth: POST /realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token (grant_type=password, client_id=strassennamen, user1/user1pass) -> access_token whose resource_access.strassennamen.roles = ["editor","app-access"]; GET /api/Strasse with Bearer token -> HTTP 200 []; GET /api/Ortsteil -> 200 []; GET /api/Stadtbezirk -> 200 [].

Keycloak admin API (admin-cli) shows client strassennamen exactly per guide: standardFlowEnabled=true, implicitFlowEnabled=true, directAccessGrantsEnabled=true, serviceAccountsEnabled=false, publicClient=true, rootUrl/baseUrl/adminUrl=http://localhost:4200/, redirectUris=[http://localhost:4200/*, http://localhost:5000/*], webOrigins=[http://localhost:4200/*], attribute post.logout.redirect_uris=http://localhost:4200/*; client roles = ['app-access','editor']; user1 role mappings = ['app-access','editor'].

Frontend served config http://localhost:4200/configs/config.development.json = {endPointUrl: http://localhost:5000/api, keycloak:{realm:my-realm, authServerUrl:http://localhost:8080/, resource:strassennamen}}.

CORS: OPTIONS preflight from Origin http://localhost:4200 -> 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:4200, Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; real request -> 200 with same headers.
Database: docker exec mssql sqlcmd -d Strassennamen "SELECT name FROM sys.tables" -> 14 rows (Strassen, Vorgaenge, Beschluesse, Ortsteile, etc.).

Backend config /workspace/src/Backend/Lecos.Strassennamen.RestAPI/appsettings.Development.json matches guide (Keycloak block, CorsOrigins ["http://localhost:4200"], ConnectionStrings.DB, Serilog file sink, Jobs Heartbeat+XmlExportStrassen active).

Jobs executed (grep /tmp/backend.log): 'Now listening on: http://localhost:5000', 'Application started', 'Calling Execute on job StrassennamenJobs.XmlExportStrassenJob', 'Calling Execute on job StrassennamenJobs.HeartbeatJob'; Export/strassen.xml exists with <Strassenverzeichnis />.
assessment_summary: I validated the full stack described in the guide: Keycloak (auth), frontend (Angular on 4200), backend (.NET REST API on 5000), and the EF-compatible SQL database. Procedure: (1) confirmed all four components are live via ps/docker and HTTP probes; (2) verified Keycloak realm/client configuration through the admin API against every requirement in the guide — client flows (standard, implicit, direct access grants enabled; client auth and service accounts disabled), root/home/admin URLs, redirect URIs for both frontend and backend, web origins, post-logout redirect, and both mandatory client roles app-access and editor, including user1's role mappings; (3) performed the end-to-end auth flow: 401 without token, direct-access-grant token issuance for user1 containing the expected roles, and 200 on three distinct API endpoints with the token; (4) verified the frontend serves the correct app (title) and the guide-shaped config.development.json; (5) verified CORS preflight and real-request headers for the configured origin; (6) confirmed the Strassennamen database exists with the 14 tables created by EF/FluentMigrator migrations; (7) confirmed the configured Quartz jobs (Heartbeat, XmlExportStrassen) ran at startup and the XML export file was produced, and that the backend appsettings.Development.json matches the guide's example. Deviations noted but not failure-causing: the guide's file paths differ slightly from actual repo locations (frontend config under public/configs/, backend config under the RestAPI project dir), and SQL Server 2022 in Docker was used in place of Windows-only LocalDB — both acceptable per the guide's own wording (any EF-compatible SQL DB; the Angular public root is the functional location). One minor friction: admin-realm password grant for client admin-realm is rejected on Keycloak 26 (invalid_client); using admin-cli worked, but this does not affect the application. No checks failed; all decisive checks returned objective positive evidence, so the outcome is success.
